plugins.name: pipcast
plugins.description: Picture in picture for Claude Code. While you work in other apps, a small window in the corner of your Mac's screen shows a live board of your sessions, and cuts to BREAKING NEWS, the way a 1990s local TV station would, when one needs you, finishes or stops on an error.
